name: Studio Arts
notes: Six courses: five studio courses (two or three at each level) plus one art history course.
No more than two TRANSFERRED studio courses are accepted toward the minor.
Students are encouraged to meet a studio arts faculty advisor early to design a coherent program of study.

requirementGroups.label: Two 100-level studio courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: A minor in studio arts requires six courses: Two or three 100-level studio courses*. *No more than two transferred studio courses will be accepted toward a minor

requirementGroups.label: Two 200- or 300-level studio courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two or three 200 or 300-level studio courses

requirementGroups.label: A fifth studio course at either level
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two or three 100-level studio courses ... Two or three 200 or 300-level studio courses
requirementGroups.note: The split is two-or-three each way, so the fifth studio course may be at either level.
